VI.description: Applies a layout computed by lvai_layout_diagram to a VI's block diagram and saves it in place. Five passes, in this order\3A MOVES, each 'path;index;left;top' - the object at that index of the diagram the path reaches is moved so that its Position becomes left,top in the pane's coordinates; SIZES, each 'path;index;width;height' - that structure's Frame Size is written, which sets its outer size exactly and keeps its top left corner (Auto Size and ShrinkWrapStructs grow a structure but never shrink it, measured 2026-10-16); TUNNELS, each 'path;index;tunnel;left;top' - that tunnel of that structure is moved; SHIFT REGISTERS, the same for a loop's Shift Registers[] (the left terminal; the right one follows); WIRES, each 'path' - every wire of that diagram is cleaned up with CleanUpWire. A path is 'object frame object frame ...' from the top-level diagram, empty for the top level itself, the ids lvbd_layout_dump writes.\0A\0AWHY EVERY OBJECT IS MOVED TWICE\3A Position reads in the pane's coordinates while Move takes a position relative to the OWNER diagram (lvbd_graft_rewire, 2026-09-30). The first Move reveals the offset, the second applies target + target - landed.\0A\0AEach pass answers ONE string, a record per op ending in '|' and its fields split by ';' - the first field the error code. An object that fails is reported with its error code and the rest go on; only opening and saving the VI stop the run.

FreeLabel.comment: Moves, sizes, tunnels, wires, then save
